rows.corpus_definition: a good feeling you get when something meets your needs or wishes
rows.example_en: He smiled with satisfaction after finishing the project.

rows.corpus_definition: good enough but not excellent; meeting the basic required standard
rows.example_en: Her exam results were satisfactory but could be better.

rows.corpus_definition: to collect money over time to buy something
rows.example_en: They save up for a summer holiday every year.

rows.corpus_definition: A tool with sharp teeth used for cutting wood or metal.
rows.example_en: The worker used a sharp saw to cut the board.

rows.corpus_definition: a permanent mark left on skin after a wound heals
rows.example_en: He had a small scar on his chin from childhood.

rows.corpus_definition: to throw or spread things in many different directions
rows.example_en: The wind scattered the fallen leaves across the yard.

rows.corpus_definition: To rub your skin with your nails to stop an itch.
rows.example_en: The cat will scratch you if you pull its tail.

rows.corpus_definition: A metal piece that you twist to join things together.
rows.example_en: I need to turn the screw to fix the chair.

rows.corpus_definition: The state of being safe from harm or danger.
rows.example_en: The airport has strict security checks.

rows.corpus_definition: One of two periods in a school year.
rows.example_en: The first semester ends in December.
